* Win the game

posts.name: Caerulo
posts.cooked:
This is what I've gathered so far from looking at all the logs from here, Discord and Steam:

Conditions:
- Akash'Thriya in team
- Play in Nexus of the Void
- Bring Akash'Thriya down to less than 10 health, and then healed to full
- Akash'Flora must be played and cannot be destroyed
- At least 4 different seeds must be played from environment/Play at least (H) seeds from the environment

Conditions that can be eliminated:
- No requirements for any other heroes
- No requirements for any villian
- No requirements for Akash'Flora to be at a particular health
- No requirements for Akash'Flora to grant any powers
- No requirements for all five seeds to be played


Variables that still need to be tested:
- Is the life threshold at 10 hp? 
- How many seeds must be played?
- Must the seed condition be unique seeds?
- Must the seeds be played by the environment?

posts.name: MigrantP
posts.cooked:
The community has discovered the official unlock condition for Akash'Thriya: Spirit of the Void.

Win a game in Nexus of the Void with Akash'Thriya on the team. Each unique primordial seed must enter the environment deck. Akash'Thriya must be reduced to 9 or less HP, then recover back to full HP. Akash'Flora must be in play at the end of the game without ever having left play.
